title: How to Read a Scientific Paper
paragraphs: Scientists write papers about their work. A paper tells us what they did and what they found.
A paper has parts. The first part is the abstract. It is short. It tells us the main idea.
Then there is the method. It says how they did the work. The results show the numbers. The discussion says what the numbers mean.
Read the abstract first. Then read the end. Ask questions. Is the study big? Do other studies say the same?
